salesTaxProfiles.title: Sales tax profile
salesTaxProfiles.hint: Choose the option that matches your RUT. This is the only choice that drives IVA or INC calculation in POS/invoices and the regime sent to Matias.
salesTaxProfiles.required: Select a profile before enabling electronic invoicing.
salesTaxProfiles.ivaHint: RUT 48. WARO calculates IVA and uses Matias' responsible regime.
salesTaxProfiles.incHint: RUT 33. For sales subject to the National Consumption Tax.
salesTaxProfiles.noIvaIncTitle: Not responsible for IVA or INC
salesTaxProfiles.noIvaIncHint: Natural person with RUT 49 and 50. Invoices contain neither IVA nor INC.
salesTaxProfiles.noIvaTitle: Not responsible for IVA; INC does not apply
salesTaxProfiles.noIvaHint: RUT 49 for activities outside restaurant or bar INC treatment.

readiness.requestBody: Enable the request in the Electronic invoicing provider section. WARO will validate technical enablement with Matias before issuing.
readiness.pendingBody: The request may be active, but WARO must complete technical enablement with Matias before issuing.
readiness.missingFiscalBody: Complete NIT, legal name, phone and email in the Business fiscal data section.
readiness.noResolutionBody: Configure an active resolution with available numbering in the DIAN resolution section.
readiness.taxReviewBody: Select the tax profile that matches the RUT. WARO must keep the IVA/INC responsibility and calculation rules aligned.
readiness.matiasUuidBody: Configure the issuer client_uuid in the Electronic invoicing provider section before issuing with Matias.
readiness.ready: Your account is ready to issue electronic invoices.

resolutions.title: DIAN resolution
resolutions.emptySub: Configure the resolution you registered in the Matias portal (number, prefix, range)
resolutions.gapsTitle: Burned numbers detected in your numbering
resolutions.gapsHint: DIAN does not allow reusing them — check the log.
resolutions.currentNumberInvalid: Must be between {from} and {to}. DIAN does not allow reusing numbers; the counter only moves forward.

fiscal.body: Fill in issuer identity, sales tax profile, optional Matias extras, and contact. The sales tax profile is what turns IVA or INC on.
fiscal.orgHint: Defines whether the issuer invoices as a natural person or legal entity.
fiscal.taxRegimeHint: Derived from the sales tax profile. Not a separate control.
fiscal.taxLevelHint: Extra issuer flags (large taxpayer, simple regime, etc.). Does not replace the sales tax profile.
fiscal.identityHint: NIT details for DIAN and Matias. These fields alone do not calculate taxes.
fiscal.extrasHint: Additional issuer responsibilities. They do not change IVA or INC calculation.

print.title: Customize POS tickets
print.bodyPrefix: Affects POS pre-invoices and printed receipts. The logo is configured in
print.docHint: Text at the top of the ticket (max. 40 characters). E.g. Pre-invoice, Order #.
print.tipHint: Tip line text on pre-invoice, printed receipt and email (max. 40 characters). E.g. Service.
print.showLogoHint: Use the My business logo on pre-invoice and printed invoice

tax.title: Taxes applied to sales
tax.body: INC/IVA flags follow the sales tax profile. Here you adjust rates, included vs added, and liquor VAT.
tax.incBody: Turns on automatically when the profile is Responsible for INC. Adjust rate and whether it is included in the price.
tax.ivaBody: Turns on automatically when the profile is Responsible for IVA. Adjust rate and whether it is included in the price.
tax.liquorBody: Additive tax on spirits. Map menu categories to this line below; always added to the base price.
tax.incIncludedHint: The 8% is already included in the price. Example: $10,800 → $10,000 base + $800 INC
tax.incAddedHint: The 8% is added on top. Example: $10,000 base → $10,800 charged
tax.ivaIncludedHint: The 19% is already included in the price. Example: $11,900 → $10,000 base + $1,900 VAT
tax.ivaAddedHint: The 19% is added on top. Example: $10,000 base → $11,900 charged
tax.commercialBody: Configure sales tax for your business country (WARO commercial mode). Country comes from registration / financial profile; here you enable or disable tax and manage tax lines and category mapping.
tax.commercialEnableBody: When off, POS and menu do not apply commercial tax. Saved rates are kept so you can turn them back on.
tax.commercialDisabledHint: Commercial tax is off. The country preset is not applied to sales; turn it on to edit rates.
tax.wave1PresetHint: Selecting a country loads rate and label. Save to apply to POS and menu.
tax.countryFromSetupHint: Country is already set in registration / financial profile. Here you only adjust the reference rate.
tax.jurisdictionHint: WARO uses a state/province reference rate. City/local meal taxes are out of v1; confirm the percentage with your accountant.
tax.jurisdictionRequired: Choose a state or province before saving.
tax.jurisdictionFromSetupHint: State or province was captured at registration. You can still adjust the percentage below if your accountant requires it.
tax.commercialIncludedHint: The rate is already included in the sale price.
tax.commercialAddedHint: The rate is added on top of the base price.
tax.commercialSaveInvalid: Choose a preset/jurisdiction or enter a name and a valid rate before saving.
tax.matrixBody: Add up to five lines. Assign menu categories to each line with the searcher. You cannot remove a line while categories still use it.
tax.categoryMapBody: Assign menu categories to each tax line with the searcher.
tax.coCategoryMapBody: Assign menu categories to IVA/INC or spirits. Unmapped categories use the profile primary line; exempt ones go in the block below.
tax.matrixTooMany: You can define at most {max} tax lines.
tax.matrixNeedOne: Keep at least one tax line while taxes are enabled.
tax.matrixLineInUse: Remap categories away from this line before removing it.

matrixError.empty_lines: Add at least one tax line.
matrixError.missing_label: Every tax line needs a name.
matrixError.invalid_rate: Rates must be zero or greater.
matrixError.no_positive_rate: At least one tax line needs a rate greater than zero.
matrixError.duplicate_key: Tax line keys must be unique.
matrixError.bad_map: Category mapping must point to an existing tax line.

tax.lineCategoriesHint: Search and add menu categories. They appear as chips.
tax.exemptNote: Exempt categories are not linked to any tax line: those products stay tax-free (unless overridden on the product).
tax.exemptHint: Pick menu categories that should not apply tax.

provider.title: Electronic invoicing provider
provider.requestBody: Indicates that you want to issue electronic invoices from WARO. This request does not replace internal enablement with Matias or change VAT or INC.
provider.matiasUuidHint: Issuer client_uuid identifier in Matias for Casa de Software. It is a technical provider requirement; it does not define your fiscal regime or sales taxes.

commercial.title: WARO documents
commercial.notice: WARO records these documents for business operations, but does not transmit or validate them with a tax authority.

audit.title: Retired number log
audit.description: Numbers removed from the DIAN sequence. Each row identifies a number that cannot be reused and keeps its auditable reason.
audit.emptyBody: Your DIAN numbering has no retired numbers.
audit.emptyForResolution: Your DIAN numbering has no retired numbers in this resolution.
audit.unavailableBody: This business uses non-fiscal WARO documents and does not query tax-authority numbering or validations.
